excerpt.zh: 我们的稀有水晶赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
excerpt.en: Our rare crystals deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

texts.zh: 我们的稀有水晶赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
texts.en: Our rare crystals deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

sections.zh: 稀有水晶月度结余为正

texts.zh: 稀有水晶在[Root.Owner.GetName]变得更加稀有了。包括关键的军用器材和先进生产设施中的核心组件，几乎各行各业都发生了短缺。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]提醒，必须在数月之内重整补给链，否则将需要大幅削减开支。
texts.en: Rare crystals are becoming increasingly scarce in the [Root.Owner.GetName]. Shortages have been reported in many fields, ranging from vital military supplies to critical components used in many advanced manufacturing processes. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] warns reforms to the supply chain will be necessary within a matter of months, failing which sharp cutbacks will be necessary.

label.zh: 从首都方舟抽取稀有水晶。
label.en: Siphon rare crystals from the Capital Arkship.

label.zh: 或许我们需要竭尽开采资源。
label.en: We will have to overexploit our deposits.

label.zh: 我们可以忍受“超稀有”水晶。
label.en: We can live with our crystals being rarer.

texts.zh: 我们稀有水晶的供给已经枯竭到即使关键系统都无法获得补充。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]调侃道如今它已经可以称呼为“极稀有”水晶了，他同时还强制执行了急剧的削减以期能恢复收支平衡。
texts.en: Our supply of rare crystals has diminished to the point that even critical systems can no longer be supported. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap], which recommends that they be renamed to "rarest crystals", is enforcing harsh cutbacks to return our usage of them to sustainable levels.

texts.zh:
我们的稀有水晶储备已消耗到无法维持多项关键功能的程度。在极端情况下，我们那些依赖这种珍贵资源的特化共生体将面临生命危险。

为避免进一步的生命损失和生产力下滑，我们现在必须采取极端手段来确保系统重新恢复平衡。
texts.en:
Our supply of Rare Crystals has diminished to the point we can no longer maintain several critical functions. In extreme instances, we risk the lives of our more specialized symbionts who depend on this precious resource.

To prevent further loss of life and productivity, we must now rely on drastic means to ensure we once again reach equilibrium.
